name: Fire
reason: Product fire, smoke or explosion reported.

name: Overheating or battery swelling
reason: Overheating or battery hazard reported.

name: Sparks or electric shock
reason: Electrical hazard reported.

name: Injury reported
reason: A person was injured by a product.

name: Child involved in a safety incident
reason: Safety incident involving a child.

name: Recall-related complaint
reason: Complaint references a product recall.

name: Safety subcategory without explicit hazard terms
reason: Complaint classified as a product safety hazard.

name: Injury subcategory
reason: Complaint classified as an injury incident.

name: Unauthorized account access
reason: Suspected unauthorized access or account takeover.

name: Smart-lock unexplained unlock
reason: Physical home security compromised (unexplained smart-lock event).

name: Fraudulent payment
reason: Suspected fraudulent payment activity.

name: Personal data or footage exposed
reason: Possible exposure of personal data or footage (privacy incident).

name: Data shared or sold without consent
reason: Personal data reportedly shared without consent.

name: Overdue data-rights request
reason: Data-rights request overdue beyond the 30-day limit.

name: Children's data involved
reason: Privacy matter involving children's data.

name: Legal threat or regulator mention
reason: Customer threatens legal action or refers to a regulator.

name: Repeat unresolved complaint (2 prior)
reason: Repeat complaint with prior unresolved complaints on the same issue.

name: Repeat unresolved complaint (3+ prior)
reason: Three or more prior unresolved complaints on the same issue.

name: Reopened complaint
reason: Complaint reopens a previously resolved complaint (failed resolution).

name: High-value dispute (USD 500+)
reason: Disputed or claimed amount of USD 500 or more.

name: High-value dispute (USD 1
reason: Disputed or claimed amount of USD 1,500 or more.

name: High-value business account order
reason: Business-account order of USD 2,500 or more affected.

name: High-value lost order
reason: Lost order valued at USD 500 or more requires Supervisor Review.

name: Severe service failure
reason: Service outage causing lost recordings or disabled home security.

name: Critical customer impact
reason: Critical impact on the customer's home (locked out, no heating/cooling, medical dependence).

name: Vulnerable person with critical impact
reason: Critical impact affecting a vulnerable person.

name: Policy exception requested
reason: Customer requests an outcome outside policy limits or windows.

name: Refund requested outside the refund window
reason: Refund requested outside the eligibility window (policy exception).

name: Compensation above agent limit
reason: Requested compensation exceeds the agent approval limit.

name: Compensation above supervisor limit
reason: Requested compensation exceeds the supervisor approval limit.

name: Late billing dispute
reason: Billing dispute raised more than 60 days after the charge.

name: Staff harassment
reason: Serious staff misconduct reported (harassment, discrimination or threats).

name: Technician property damage or theft
reason: Property damage or theft allegation against a technician.

name: Staff commitment outside policy
reason: Staff member made a commitment that must be checked against policy.

name: Public media threat
reason: Customer threatens public or media exposure.

name: Chargeback threat
reason: Customer mentions a chargeback or bank dispute.

name: Replacement also defective
reason: The replacement product is also defective.

name: Warranty denial appeal
reason: Warranty denial appeals are reviewed by a Warranty Services supervisor.

name: SLA breach on P0/P1
reason: SLA breached on a P0/P1 complaint.
